correctness.rationale: Connected L has kernel span(1), so its n columns are affinely independent in 1^⊥, centroid 0. Vertex transitivity implies degree k and equal squared column norms k(k+1). Averaged squared distances give unique circumcenter and R. Barycentric coordinates α_i(x)=1/n+⟨L⁺e_i,x⟩, so facet clearance at origin is 1/(n||L⁺e_i||). Automorphism transitivity equalizes norms and Frobenius trace gives q=||L⁺e_i||²=(1/n)Σ_{j≥2}λ_j⁻². Summing constraints α_i(x)≥ρ√q gives sharp unique inradius 1/(n√q), all facets tangent. Independent exact rational SymPy tested K2,K5,C6,Q3, including barycentric normals and spectral traces; cycle fourth-cosecant identity numerically tested n=3..14.
